name: Dracula

abilityDetails.Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Degeneration: Rakibe zamanla doğrudan, engellenemez hasar verir.
abilityDetails.Slow: Düşmanın Durdurulamaz (Unstoppable) ve Kaçış (Evade) yeteneklerini iptal eder.
abilityDetails.Fear: Unblockable yetenek doğruluğunu sabit %100 azaltır ve Mükemmel Blok Şansını kaldırır.
abilityDetails.Power Steal: Hedefin gücünü azaltıp aynı miktarı kendine kazandırır.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Bloğuna vurursan 2sn görünmez olup karşılık verir — bloğuna vurma ya da görünmezlik-karşıtı şampiyon kullan. Bonusunu nötralize edersen pasif kanama uygular. Özel saldırılarında pasif iyileşir — iyileşme oranını azaltan şampiyon tercih et.
signatureAbility:
The Prince of Darkness
As an Attacker, when the Opponent's Unblockable, Unstoppable, or Evade effects fail due to reduced Ability Accuracy, inflict a [2,573.43 - 5,279.5] Bleed Passive for 3 seconds.
Dracula gains +[2,573.43 - 5,279.5] Attack Rating for each Armor Break Debuff he is suffering from, up to 5.

abilitySections.title: Blood of Vampires
content: Dracula's vampiric blood makes him Immune to Heal Block, but while fighting #Silver Champions he suffers -25% Regeneration Rate.
Driven by bloodthirst, Dracula only benefits from half the potency of the Mystic Dispersion Mastery, but after a Buff on the Opponent is Nullified he inflicts a [3,167.7] Bleed Passive for 3 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Dread of Night - Dire Degeneration
content: Dracula strikes terror into the very souls of mortals. As an Attacker, at the start of each fight, inflict a Degeneration Passive dealing [844,720] Direct Damage over 666 seconds. This is unaffected by Ability Accuracy and scales with Base Attack only.
Charging a Heavy Attack or Interrupting any attack with a Light Attack makes this Degeneration Dire, increasing its tick rate by 666%.
The Degeneration remains Dire as long as Dracula continues attacking, or while a Striker or Striker Opening are active.

abilitySections.title: Form of Mist - Invisibility
content: Hitting the Opponent's Block with a Basic Attack grants Dracula an Invisibility Buff for 2 seconds. This will not re-trigger while active.
If this Invisibility causes an attack to Miss, or if Dracula is struck while it's active, it goes on cooldown for 12 seconds when it ends.

abilitySections.title: Vampiric Drain - Special Attacks
content: During his Special Attacks 1 and 2, Dracula gains a Regeneration Passive healing 0.25% of his Max Health per second. The tick rate of this Regeneration is increased by half of the Dire Degeneration's increased tick rate.
Each sword hit Nullifies a Buff on the Opponent. If a Fury Buff is Nullified, Dracula steals it to gain a Fury Buff with twice the potency until the end of the Special Attack. Max potency: +[10,559].

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1 - Wallachian Warlord
content: On activation, inflict a Slow Passive for 40 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2 - Dark Cloud
content: During this attack, Dracula's Degeneration becomes Dire, increasing its tick rate by 666%. If it was already Dire, its tick rate is instead increased to 1200%.
Each bat hit inflicts a Fear Passive for 60 seconds. This can be inflicted through Block.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3 - A Night Eternal
content: Inflict a Power Steal Passive stealing a Bar of Power over 3 seconds.
At the end of this attack, inflict a [17,168.93] Bleed Passive for 3 seconds. If the Opponent is below 30% Health, this Bleed gains up to 1260% base potency based on their missing Health.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - The Prince of Darkness
content: As an Attacker, when the Opponent's Unblockable, Unstoppable, or Evade effects fail due to reduced Ability Accuracy, inflict a [2,573.43 - 5,279.5] Bleed Passive for 3 seconds.
Dracula gains +[2,573.43 - 5,279.5] Attack Rating for each Armor Break Debuff he is suffering from, up to 5.
